# Amazon GuardDuty Client

The `aws-sdk-guardduty` package provides a client for making
requests to Amazon GuardDuty.

> **Note:** This SDK is in Developer Preview. Breaking changes may occur prior
> to the release of version 4.0.0.

## Installation

```bash
python -m pip install aws-sdk-guardduty
```
